LESSON: HOMEMADE SUN DRYER

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: AGRICULTURE
Strand: Production Techniques
Topic 4.2: Homemade Sun Dryer

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Homemade Sun Dryer. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Homemade Sun Dryer
2. Give Kenyan examples for Homemade Sun Dryer
3. Practise Homemade Sun Dryer at school and at home

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: HOMEMADE SUN DRYER
This lesson teaches Homemade Sun Dryer for Grade 9 AGRICULTURE.

STUDY STEPS
1. Explain the main ideas in Homemade Sun Dryer
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. Give Kenyan examples for Homemade Sun Dryer
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. Practise Homemade Sun Dryer at school and at home
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Homemade Sun Dryer using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Homemade Sun Dryer above.
2. Explain Homemade Sun Dryer to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Homemade Sun Dryer.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Homemade Sun Dryer with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Homemade Sun Dryer important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Homemade Sun Dryer
2. Give Kenyan examples for Homemade Sun Dryer
3. Practise Homemade Sun Dryer at school and at home

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
